purpose: Maps every physical M1 table to its logical ERD entity and records every known column difference. backend/tests/check_physical_catalog.py fails CI when the migrations or the ERD drift from this file; update it deliberately, never to silence the checker.

tables.note: M1 is family-scoped. Billing owner, founding rank and the revocation epoch belong to later milestones; the revocation generation is kept in revocation_epochs. `label` is M1-only.
M1 stores only the OIDC identity. Google verification time, adult-authority state and disable time are not modelled until the consent and authority work (ADR child-scoped V2).
Same shape; two renamed columns and a created_at. revoked_at exists on both sides.

Tenant-model difference: M1 children belong to exactly one family (family_id); the ERD names it home_family_id and adds cross-family V2 access. Physical `alias` replaces encrypted display_name for synthetic M1 data. Erasure epoch, deletion time and device_status are later work.
M1 grants are inside one family and carry family_id for row-level security. The ERD grant is cross-family and needs an authority review and a revocation epoch (V2); not implemented.
Physical adds family_id (RLS), attempt_count (20-attempt cap) and created_at.
Physical stores the SPKI public key and algorithm directly; the ERD keeps only an opaque public_key_ref. android_api and device_mode live in capability_snapshots in M1; last_seen_at is not stored.
Physical records both consumed_at (challenge spent, migration 0001) and redeemed_at (activation completed, migration 0003) instead of a state enum, and has no audience column (one purpose in M1).
No key_epoch in M1: key rotation is out of scope (decision C-06).
Physical stores android_api and device_mode (assumed equal to the ERD management_mode; confirm when the ERD is revised) plus is_device_owner and received_at; os_reject_reasons is not stored in M1.

One current row per device (device_id is the key, as in the ERD). M1 stores battery, charging, permission revision and observed/recorded times; network status, queue pressure and last_seen_at are later work.
Physical carries family_id (RLS). child_id, reason_code and the idempotency_key column are not stored on the row: idempotency lives in idempotency_keys.
Device proof and failure_reason are not stored in M1 (proof is verified at enrollment and renewal only, decision C-03).
M1 audit rows reference the acting principal or device in two columns instead of one actor_ref, and have neither child_ref, digest nor trace id.

Deliberate deviation (migration 0004): the primary key includes the actor so callers cannot collide or probe each other; the table also stores the request hash and the response so a replay can be answered. Reconcile the ERD entity with this design.
Short-lived opaque device bearer credential (decision C-01). Physical adds issued_at and issued_via; latest_ip_hash is not stored.

physical_without_entity.reason: Introduced by migrations 0002/0003 (device credential renewal). The ERD has no entity for single-use renewal challenges; add one next to device_sessions when the ERD is next revised.
